source_instruction: i am looking for a 25 pack of micellar makeup remover wipes that are sulfate free.
query: My roommate’s cat knocked over my pothos plant this morning and spilled potting soil all over the entryway rug, and I spent almost an hour scrubbing it out before I remembered I left my lavender candle burning on the bathroom windowsill and had to rush to blow it out before the wax dripped onto the tile. I also stopped on my walk earlier to chat with the neighbor who grows the juiciest cherry tomatoes on the block, and she said she’d drop a bag of them off later this week if her plants keep producing like they have been. I’ve heard that sulfate free makeup remover works really well for people with easily irritated skin, and that the 25 count (pack of 2) version of the ones sold here usually rings up under $20.
